//: lib: ["ES2021", "ESNext.Iterator"] is the floor this package actually needs. WeakRef/FinalizationRegistry (KindaWeakMap.ts) land in ES2021; verified ES2020 fails on both (TS2304). MapIterator itself is declared in lib.es2015.iterable, but the `.map()`/`.filter()` calls on it (entries()/values()/clear()) are ES2025 Iterator-helper methods that only lib.esnext.iterator.d.ts adds -- verified ES2021 alone fails on both (TS2339) while carrying WeakRef fine. No ES-numbered lib bundles those helpers yet, hence the explicit ESNext.Iterator sliver rather than a bump to a numbered year. DOM is absent -- nothing here needs it.
